contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Return count successive xorshift32 states, excluding the initial seed. Each step substitutes 0x2545F491 for zero then applies signed-32-bit x ^= x << 13, x ^= x >>> 17, x ^= x << 5. Count zero returns an empty array. This sequence is deterministic.
contract.domain: Seed is a signed 32-bit integer; count is an integer from 0 through 32.

inputRoles.seed: initial signed 32-bit state, excluded from output
inputRoles.count: number of advanced states to return

contract.outputRole: fresh array of successive states, first element after one step
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
